decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ('Chiswick Park Footbridge - Design and Access Statement' dated August 2015 (including amendments February 2017), and drawings 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, and 012; all received 16 October 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details of the materials (including paint finishes, colours and materials samples where appropriate) to be used for the external surfaces of the development (including details of the safety enclosure balustrade system) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with Network Rail before the identified part of the development to which the materials relate is commenced, and this condition shall apply notwithstanding any indications to these matters which have been given in this application. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - External lighting associated with the footbridge shall be installed, operated and retained permanently thereafter accordance with Section 12.0 of the 'Chiswick Park Footbridge - Design and Access Statement' dated August 2015, received 16 October 2015 (including amendments February 2017).

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the 'Chiswick Park Footbridge - Environmental Management' Rev. 01 by Lend Lease dated 12 October 2015, received 16 October 2015.
description: Construction of a pedestrian footbridge between Chiswick Business Park and Bollo Lane / Colonial Drive
